sources.claim: Low-mass lunar cable concept: 10 kV DC, 10 kW, up to 4 km; not mission telemetry.

input_kind: Synthetic engineering scenarios inspired by catalogue scale; no measured cable performance
material: Assumed copper-like resistivity 1.72e-8 ohm m and density 8960 kg/m3; neither supplier material nor flight cable specification
resistance_sensitivity: Multipliers 1, 1.5 and 2 are assumed stress cases, not a measured temperature curve or confidence interval
rights: URLs and factual metadata only; NASA images and catalogue text not redistributed. Original scenarios and code use repository license.
units: SI except conductor area in mm2; length is one-way; two conductors counted
limitations: DC resistive equilibrium, not the AC LunaGrid-Lite demonstration; no insulation, converters, thermal limits or qualification
